text: Program Highlight Ecological building materials and its key technology, High-performance metals and engineering, Advanced polymer materials and engineering, New composite materials and engineering, Biomedical Materials and Engineering, New composite material technology, Material molding new technology, Photoelectron and information material, New energy materials and technology Teaching Objective This program is targeted to cultivate advanced talents to undertake research, teaching and engineering technology and management of Material Science and Engineering and also innovative in all those fields with a profound theoretical knowledge, fundamental skills in experimentation and systematical comprehension of the field of Material Science and Engineering. Duration 2.5 years
